digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow pass-1 model selection and escalation
propositions: Pass-1 finders resolve model_ladder entries to bare Anthropic ids regardless of configured provider, causing split-brain where non-Anthropic runs invoke Anthropic models directly
Model escalation returns bare Anthropic ids even when a Bedrock-qualified primary is current, forcing silent cross-provider escalation
model_ladder is expressed as bare model ids rather than provider-agnostic class names, making it non-portable across provider configurations
Three separate code sites consume model_ladder[0] (production_batch_runner, code_review/batch_runner, workflow/runners) without resolving class names, each repeating the split-brain bug
sizing.MODEL_LADDER drives two independent behaviors (escalation order and context-window budget via substring match) requiring decoupled handling to avoid silent budget changes
